scope: Method Y PET-assisted exploratory branch only; does not change Method X-Strict

tier_rationale.primary_feasible_90: Union of gold_standard_30 (<=30d) and primary_strict (30-90d); one PET per patient; N=266 linked with abs PET-T1 gap <=90 days.
tier_rationale.primary_strict_only: Sensitivity/high-validity subset only (191 rows; min class 23). Not approved as sole primary training tier.
tier_rationale.gold_standard_30: Report-only high-validity sensitivity (75 rows; min class 11).

forbidden_claims: Method Y PET model replaces or upgrades Method X non-invasive claim
PET-only model generalizes to full 1700 MRI cohort without sample-selection caveat
Class-imbalance-corrected AUC proves biological PET signal alone

comparison_scope.mri_only_baseline: Same Method Y eligible sample set (hash intersection), not full 1700 unless explicitly reported separately
comparison_scope.note: 266 PET samples is a PET-MRI temporally linked subset, not a failure of MRI preprocessing.
